svg.title: The surge gathered pace through 2025
svg.desc: Colored lines mark when coding tools became available: GitHub Copilot on 21 June 2022, Cursor Agent on 24 November 2024, and Codex in research preview on 16 May 2025. Launch dates are not adoption dates or evidence of an AI effect. Annual growth compares the same quarter a year earlier and begins in 2021 Q1.
svg.metadata: Data: GitHub Innovation Graph (CC0), https://github.com/github/innovationgraph/tree/078fb62ee4395d321bec9f4f06694cca68f6b6cb/data. Maps: Natural Earth (public domain); DataMeet India, CC BY 4.0, adapted. Full linked attribution accompanies each map in the gallery and notes.
